issues.title: Ingest Sevier County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $17,444,990 across 29 funds. The largest: County General ($4,392,106), County Road ($3,245,245), Solid Waste Fund ($2,635,247). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
